answer: Tie each identity to one verified property deed, with only its hash stored: like quartz, the record is hard and singular, not something you can mint by the dozen. A sybil farmer would need a separate real deed for every fake, each bought at property prices, while honest owners hold one ivory deed each at the vertex of their own household. Duplicate hashes are rejected on sight. Limit: it excludes renters and people without property, so deeds must be one option among several, not the only gate.
